name: Picture legend
responsibility: Reads a picture's key back from its drawn scene: the appearance each subject was drawn with, and the distinct samples among them
description: picture_legend(body) -> PictureLegend { subjects, kinds, relationships }, each an Applied appearance (Drawn and its icon). Every painter and the exported legend read the key here, so they cannot list different things (TASK-468).

outgoing.label: the drawn scene it reads the key from
